title: Inverse and implicit function theorems; submanifolds
summary: The inverse function theorem with its contraction-mapping proof; the implicit function theorem in Banach form; critical points and regular values; submanifolds and the regular-value theorem; the orthogonal group as a manifold; existence and uniqueness for ODEs via the inverse function theorem.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is lectures 4–5 of the 18.965 notes (Theorems 5.1–5.2, Definition 5.3, Corollary 5.4, §6) with Hitchin §10.1 as a second proof of the inverse function theorem.

preparation.description: Read lecture 4: Theorem 5.1 (inverse function theorem) and its contraction-mapping proof, Theorem 5.2 (implicit function theorem), Definition 5.3 (submanifold), Corollary 5.4.
Read lecture 5 §6: O(n) as the preimage of a regular value; the ODE existence argument. Compare with Hitchin's appendix §10.1.
